mechanism_narrative: A 2% quarterly increase in GDP signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of quarters with 2%+ GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary cycle, increasing borrowing costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of tightening cycles with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, a 0.3pp increase in UNRATE and a 1% decrease in PAYEMS signal labor market softening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp & PAYEMS falls > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in slowdown periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2% monthly increase in INDPRO signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of months with 2%+ INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1600, it indicates a strong housing market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 55% of instances with HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, a 0.5% decrease in FEDFUNDS and a 1% increase in RSAFS signal increased monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.5% & RSAFS rises > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 6-month rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in recovery periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 0.2pp decrease in UNRATE signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative in > 50% of instances with 0.2pp UNRATE decrease.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 270, it indicates increased inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL > 270.
